content: Vite's import.meta.glob supports a { query: '?raw', import: 'default' } option to import file contents as a plain string (browser-safe, no Node APIs), and eager or lazy (dynamic import per match) loading. Common static-site patterns (Astro content collections, VitePress createContentLoader) parse frontmatter+markdown at build time in Node; for a client-rendered Vite+React SPA without a custom build step, the equivalent is: import.meta.glob raw strings, then parse frontmatter (regex split + js-yaml) and render markdown (react-markdown) in a plain TS loader module evaluated in the browser bundle. import.meta.glob patterns must be static string literals -- no dynamic interpolation.
